name: @adelaide-sphere/contracts
description: OpenAPI document and generated TypeScript contracts for the Adelaide Sphere API (no persistence models).

scripts.check: openapi-typescript openapi/api.json -o src/api.generated.check.d.ts && cmp -s src/api.d.ts src/api.generated.check.d.ts; status=$?; rm -f src/api.generated.check.d.ts; exit $status
